'''Marianne Synnes ''' (born 5 June 1970) is a Norwegian [[medical laboratory scientist]], [[molecular biologist]] and politician.

==Political career==
Synnes was elected representative to the [[Storting]] for the period 2017&ndash;2021 for the [[Conservative Party (Norway)|Conservative Party]], from the constituency of [[Møre og Romsdal (Storting constituency)|Møre og Romsdal]].<ref name=storting>{{Stortingetbio|MS|accessdate=2017-10-07}}</ref>
